description: Add one more 24-hour campaign to your Promo Board listing, starting when the current one ends. Price: 0.01 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"promo_renew_listing"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/promo/renew

id.description: listing id returned by /api/promo/create, 16 characters (required), aliases listing, listing_id

token.description: owner_token returned by /api/promo/create, starts with yzp_ (required), alias owner_token

name: promo_renew_listing
